text: dsh-tool-codegraph 是面向 DSH Web、桌面和 CLI 会话的代码导航插件。它将本机 CodeGraph 命令行工具接入 agent，提供索引状态检查、索引同步、符号搜索、代码区域探索、调用者与被调用者查询、影响范围分析、符号或文件查看、项目文件结构查询及受影响测试查找。agent 可用这些工具了解代码结构并定位相关实现；调用关系分析可能遗漏动态分发边，因此系统提示建议需要完整结果时使用 grep。使用前需安装 codegraph CLI 并由用户初始化索引。

dsh-tool-codegraph adds ten CodeGraph tools to DSH for index status and sync, symbol search, code exploration, call relationships, impact analysis, file lookup, and affected tests. Install the codegraph CLI and initialize its index yourself. Use grep when complete call-graph results are required.
想让 DSH agent 帮我查找代码库里的符号定义。
有没有办法快速了解某个模块的代码结构和调用路径？
我想知道改动一个函数可能影响哪些代码。
能不能从项目索引里查看文件结构和符号详情？
帮我找出哪些函数调用了这个方法，或者这个方法调用了谁。
Help me navigate a codebase by searching symbols and exploring how an area works.
I need to estimate the impact of changing a function and find related tests.
dsh-tool-codegraph 的功能「索引状态检查」：调用 codegraph_status 查看代码索引的状态和统计信息。 由 agent 调用对应工具触发，结果作为终端卡片和模型可读文本返回。
dsh-tool-codegraph 的功能「索引同步」：调用 codegraph_sync 同步上次索引后的代码变更；该操作使用较长超时。 由 agent 调用对应工具触发，结果作为终端卡片和模型可读文本返回。
dsh-tool-codegraph 的功能「符号与区域导航」：按符号名称搜索，或探索指定区域并返回相关源码和调用路径。 由 agent 调用对应工具触发，结果作为终端卡片和模型可读文本返回。
dsh-tool-codegraph 的功能「调用关系与影响分析」：查询符号的调用者、被调用者或变更影响范围，可为影响分析指定深度。 由 agent 调用对应工具触发，结果作为终端卡片和模型可读文本返回。
dsh-tool-codegraph 的功能「符号、文件与受影响测试」：查看符号或文件详情、索引中的文件结构，并根据变更文件查找受影响测试。 由 agent 调用对应工具触发，结果作为终端卡片和模型可读文本返回。

@m1khal3v/dsh-tool-codegraph README · Introduction：

dsh-tool-codegraph

CodeGraph navigation tools for DeepSeek Harness.
A DSH plugin that wraps the open-source codegraph CLI (an AST/tree-sitter code index) into ten focused agent tools — status, search, callers/callees, impact, explore, and more.

@m1khal3v/dsh-tool-codegraph README · Introduction：> **This package is a thin wrapper.** All indexing and querying is done by the
> [codegraph](https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph) CLI — install it first
> and make sure its binary is on `PATH`.

---

@m1khal3v/dsh-tool-codegraph README · ⚡️ Highlights：- 🧭 **Orientation-first workflow** — usage rules (`status → sync → explore → targeted lookups`) are injected into the agent system prompt automatically.
- 🧰 **Ten focused tools**, one per operation — no mega-tool with an `action` parameter.
- ⚡ **O(1) indexed lookups** — light outputs for the main session, heavy explore builds routed to subagents.
- ⚠️ **Honest about soundness** — callers/callees/impact can miss dynamic-dispatch edges; the prompt tells the model when to fall back to `grep`.

@m1khal3v/dsh-tool-codegraph README · 2. Check the wrapped CLI：```sh
codegraph status
```

If the binary is missing, the tools reply with an install hint and the agent
falls back to `grep`-based search.

@m1khal3v/dsh-tool-codegraph README · 3. Initialize the index — your call：There is deliberately **no init tool** in the set above: following the codegraph
project's own recommendation, indexing should be kicked off by the user, not by
an agent. When `codegraph status` reports a missing index, run it yourself:

```sh
codegraph init
```

Until you do, the tools report the missing index and the agent keeps working
with other search tools.

@m1khal3v/dsh-tool-codegraph README · 🖥 Desktop：This plugin works in DSH Desktop as well as the CLI:

- Install it through the app's **Plugins** page.
- The `codegraph` CLI must be available on `PATH` of the desktop host process.
- All ten tools work in desktop sessions; no separate client half is needed.

@m1khal3v/dsh-tool-codegraph README · 🧰 Tools：| Tool | Purpose | Output |
|---|---|---|
| `codegraph_status` | Index health and statistics | light |
| `codegraph_sync` | Sync changes since the last index | long |
| `codegraph_search` | Find a symbol by name | light |
| `codegraph_explore` | Map an area with verbatim source and call paths | heavy |
| `codegraph_callers` | Who calls this symbol (unsound) | light |
| `codegraph_callees` | What this symbol calls | light |
| `codegraph_impact` | Blast radius of changing a symbol | light |
| `codegraph_node` | One symbol's details or a file view | light |
| `codegraph_files` | Project file structure from the index | light |
| `codegraph_affected` | Find test files affected by changed source files | light |

@m1khal3v/dsh-tool-codegraph README · ⚙️ Configuration：| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `executable` | `codegraph` | Binary name or path of the wrapped CLI |
| `queryTimeoutMs` | `10000` | Timeout for regular commands |
| `initTimeoutMs` | `60000` | Timeout for `init` / `sync` |

@m1khal3v/dsh-tool-codegraph README · 🧑‍💻 Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run verify    # typecheck + test
pnpm run build
```
